history.summary: A freehold 398 sqft 1BR shoebox (Pavilion Square, D14) 680m from Aljunied MRT at $629k / $1,580 psf — a very low entry quantum with a modest 3.3% CAGR. Affordable freehold city-fringe shoebox with decent transit, but tiny size and a niche 1BR exit cap it.
history.rating_rationale: The low $629k quantum and freehold tenure make this an accessible city-fringe rental shoebox, and 680m to Aljunied EW9 supports tenant demand. But the psf ($1,580) is ~2% above the $1,552 URA median (no discount), the 398 sqft is a tight shoebox with a niche resale/exit pool, and the 3.3% CAGR (only 20 txns) is modest and not bankable. Yield is the draw, not appreciation — a balanced Neutral.

3.3% CAGR on only 20 txns — modest and unreliable
catalysts: Freehold at a low $629k quantum — accessible entry
Paya Lebar Central transformation supporting the precinct

history.summary: The -17.2% cheapness does not survive a transaction check — asking $1,580 psf is at-to-above the project's recent $1,380-1,632 psf range — and it carries a bedroom/sqft data flag on a tiny 398 sqft Geylang shoebox.
history.rating_rationale: Pavilion Square's last-12-month transactions ran $1,380-1,632 psf (avg ~$1,530), so the $1,580 psf asking is roughly at market and above average, not the -17.2% age-adj discount the algo reports — the cheapness appears to be a scoring artifact rather than a verified bargain. The dossier also carries a bedroom_sqft_mismatch red flag and the cohort is thin (4 txns), further weakening the value read. It's a 398 sqft freehold shoebox in a 42-unit Geylang block (a vice-belt with mixed management/occupancy reviews); freehold is not a forward edge and D14 has no dated catalyst here. Score 1000=789 but the underlying value claim is unconfirmed.
